question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b99375c79ef2523c7b4fdef2ab74bc4b9d6bb52c20b0cc4bd016d0eded4cdba.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

1) SYGM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0251120b7d48d07b49a4078a0bcb45af2a527d07d17f40cf5d1bc8a0185b9052.png] 

= 19 + 25 + 7 + 13

= 64 → Even

2) DBJH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3691f6dd7687de52d4fb421c57caff7fe1ad7253da97bef575dabdf1831b9775.png] 

 

= 4 + 2 + 10 + 8

= 24 → Even

3) LRPV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3860c2869a63eb33785ea8f6ef64f6809d0479ccf16a0799b7db002aac5bcc67.png] 

= 12 + 18 + 16 + 22

= 68 → Even 

4) CNDV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af20cc300c773da486d0b74dfe5759f9bbbf805818abd7ab64cf8060f07a03ea.png] 

= 3 + 14 + 4 + 22

= 43 → **Prime and Odd.**

∴ Here, 'CNDV' is different from other three alternatives.

Hence, the correct answer is **"CNDV".**
